capabilities: Create and edit mind maps in the Obsidian central editor
Store maps as plain Markdown outline files readable by any text editor
Mark nodes as Now, Minor, Todo, or Done and show only key nodes
Drill into a node tree and save the view as a shortcut
Add AI editing rules and copy AI location paths for agent editing
extras: Freemium: 14-day full-feature trial, then a one-time ¥48 early-bird license unlocks the original features (Now/Minor nodes, shortcuts, AI rules, level folding); desktop only, fully local with no external API calls, and the license forbids redistribution or commercial resale.
motivation: The author designed it from the ground up to be AI-friendly because other mind-map tools lock data in private formats that AI agents cannot directly read or modify.
problem: Most mind-map software stores maps in proprietary formats that AI agents cannot read or edit, and maps become unusable once they grow large.
summary: Mind-mapping plugin that stores maps as plain Markdown outline files, edited directly in the Obsidian editor and by AI agents.
